summary.key_distinction: AUD, CAD, EUR, GBP and JPY are DAILY_READY: canonical official-source collectors, candidate builders and currency-only deterministic dry-run apply paths are certified. DAILY_READY never means uncontrolled publication; live runtime persistence remains fail-closed and gated.

AUD.source: ASX 30 Day Interbank Cash Rate futures (IB)
AUD.methodology: Direct official ASX settlement prices transformed as 100 minus settlement; canonical Dec-26/Mar-27/Sep-27 buckets; no interpolation.
AUD.weekly_reference_rule: Use the fifth prior complete official ASX trading session (T-5).
AUD.next_required: Operational daily refresh permitted under the shared fail-closed persistence gate.

CAD.methodology: Direct official Montréal Exchange CRA settlement prices transformed as 100 minus settlement; canonical quarterly contracts; no interpolation.
CAD.weekly_reference_rule: Use the complete official MX session nearest to as_of minus 7 calendar days.
CAD.next_required: Operational daily refresh permitted under the shared fail-closed persistence gate.

EUR.methodology: Direct official Eurex FST3 daily settlement prices transformed as 100 minus settlement; fixed Dec-26/Mar-27/Sep-27 quarterly buckets; no interpolation.
EUR.weekly_reference_rule: Use the nearest valid official Eurex busDate on or before as_of minus 5 calendar days.
EUR.next_required: Operational daily refresh permitted under the shared fail-closed persistence gate.

GBP.source: Bank of England estimated sterling OIS forward curve
GBP.methodology: Exact 3M/6M/12M official BoE short-end OIS forward-curve columns; no interpolation.
GBP.weekly_reference_rule: Use homogeneous official BoE current/T-1/T-5 observations.
GBP.next_required: Operational daily refresh permitted under the shared fail-closed persistence gate.

JPY.source: Tokyo Financial Exchange Three-month TONA Futures
JPY.methodology: Direct official TFX settlement prices transformed as 100 minus settlement; canonical quarterly contracts; no interpolation.
JPY.weekly_reference_rule: Use the nearest complete official TFX session on or before as_of minus 5 calendar days.
JPY.next_required: Operational daily refresh permitted under the shared fail-closed persistence gate.

promotion_rule: DAILY_READY allows repeatable source collection and deterministic dry-run refresh. Persistent live_data publication remains separately fail-closed and gated.
